# Synthetic fixtures

These files contain invented instrument names, sample identifiers, peak values, and signal
values. They do not contain user or vendor data. They are part of Ordifile and are licensed
under Apache-2.0.

`generic_peaks.xlsx` is generated by `generate_xlsx.py`. Regenerate it from the repository root:

```console
python tests/fixtures/synthetic/generate_xlsx.py
```

The committed workbook is intentional: integration tests exercise the same redistributable
fixture that the support table describes.

The generator fixes workbook properties, archive member order, timestamps, ZipInfo metadata,
and uses `ZIP_STORED` so output bytes do not depend on the host zlib implementation. Its
expected SHA-256 is recorded below:

```text
generic_peaks.xlsx  df36be466410ed5c02d75723ec59ed6c896fad2be51ec4bb8f6edcab937fce96
```
